Setup notes

Maps
Start with OpenMap for continuous zoom or MapUtils for the standard map with extras. HiddenMaps adds live tracking in supported dungeon entrance areas.
Gear
Start with one gear planner. GearQuest tracks specific upgrades, Forever Leveling BiS ranks them, and OneForAll includes a planner in its wider toolkit.
UI
Use one addon for each shared UI element or automation, especially nameplates, minimap buttons, and quest hand-ins. Dialogue UI and DialogKey share some keyboard controls.
Gathering
GatherLite records past finds. Node Sight shows nearby nodes. Use either Node Sight or Forever Loot Sparkles for herb and ore sparkles.
Voiceover
Install Spoken: English through the CurseForge app. If you also use Lore Forever, leave its optional quest dialogue off to avoid hearing quests twice.
Downloads are CurseForge project totals across versions, checked November 3, 2026.
